randomized-block-design.description: Size of the additive day offset, in minutes. Receiving lessons must validate their own model/domain conditions.

randomized-block-design.label: Mean within-day B−A difference
randomized-block-design.description: Compare B with A within each of three days, then average those paired differences. An additive day offset moves both methods together and cancels from their same-day comparison.

normal-mean-interval.description: Observed sample mean error, in millimetres. Receiving lessons must validate their own model/domain conditions.

normal-mean-interval.description: Known positive population standard deviation, in millimetres. Receiving lessons must validate their own model/domain conditions.

normal-mean-interval.label: Normal-mean interval margin
normal-mean-interval.description: Divide the known population standard deviation by the square root of the whole-number sample size. Multiply that standard error by the standard normal 0.975 quantile, then place the resulting margin on each side of the observed mean.
